Actually viewed source-specific features: The exact source is a fully opaque chest-up painted rectangle. Mature clean-shaven face in a three-quarter turn toward screen right, with short grey-brown temple hair, separate subdued grey-brown hair eyebrows under the cap brim, serious slightly parted mouth and no spectacles. Tall olive peaked cap has gold cord/trim, glossy black visor and band, a small lower gold wreath with pale/red circular center and a separate upper small gold bird emblem. Olive closed tunic has black upper collar, red collar tabs with gold leaf groups, a narrow red front edge, small gold front button and partly cropped shoulder trim. Preserve the exact rightward head/eye angle, slightly open mouth, chest-up crop, soft upper-left lighting and complete pale grey-beige painted backing. Tiny emblem engraving and individual hair strands are not legible at 156x210; preserve the visible groups without adding detail or new badges.
Keep the actual hairstyle, hairline, visible temple hair, distinct source eyebrow HAIR and its color. Keep the clean-shaven yellow upper lip and chin smooth: no invented moustache, beard or goatee. Shadows and fine pixel texture do not establish new facial hair. Preserve original expression, mouth openness, gaze, pose, lighting, framing, cap, uniform, collar tabs, existing decorations and shoulder details. Do not infer appearance from filename or biography or invent new insignia, objects, text or people. No human nose, ears or skin.
The compact round head sits low at the original garment neckline through a VERY SHORT BROAD transition. Refit the source collar circumference and shoulder line to this body while preserving its exact original open or closed fastening. Cloth has coherent front/back overlap, tension and contact shadow. No long yellow neck stalk or chest funnel, pinched human collar ring, floating cloth, clipping, cream belly patch at the neckline, projected human lips or extra mouth.
Preserve the COMPLETE original rectangular painted background through all four corners with opaque subject and dark fabric. No cutout, transparent holes, altered vignette, haze, halo, new photo frame or note. Keep high-resolution painterly detail and the original portrait aspect ratio. One final independent asset, no comparison board or watermark.
Output background: the exact original was visually verified to be a COMPLETE rectangular painted portrait, with no fully transparent source pixels. Its small original alpha variation does not establish an exterior figure cutout. Preserve the entire original background colour, texture, lighting and crop to all four canvas edges. Return a fully opaque rectangular image, alpha 255 throughout the originally opaque backdrop and subject, including hair, glasses, dark clothing and corners. Do not copy an incorrect target cutout mask or partial transparency. No transparent backdrop, fog, see-through fabric, haze, halo or invented frame/note. Keep every unrelated source feature unchanged.
